gloss: tops (clothing worn on the upper body)

definitions.explanation: A collective word for clothing worn on the upper body, such as shirts, blouses, T-shirts, and sweaters. Common in shops, fashion magazines, and online store categories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧トップス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧トップス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: This top goes with any skirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トップス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{黒|くろ}い→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧⟦ボトムス→ボトムス：33930_botomusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{締|し}まって→引き締まる：15200_hikishimaru⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Pairing a brightly colored top with black bottoms makes the whole outfit look sharper.

notes:
From English "tops." The form ends in ス even when it refers to a single garment. In everyday speech many people say ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ (the top half of an outfit) or name the garment itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- トップス⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ボトムス→ボトムス：33930_botomusu⟧: tops and bottoms
- ⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トップス: a short-sleeved top
- トップス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to pair (something) with a top

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ボトムス→ボトムス：33930_botomusu⟧: bottoms — the counterpart
- ⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧: jacket, outer garment — something worn over other clothes, not a top in general
